issue_context.title: [Requested enhancement] `PIE804` autofix
issue_context.body:
It seems non-breaking to replace
```
**{
    "foo": foo_value,
    "bar": bar_value,
  }
```
with
```
foo=foo_value,
bar=bar_value,
```
, unless I'm missing something. Dynamic keys might be trickier but could be excluded from an initial implementation.

review_comments: I restructured it such that, when we validate the keyword arguments, we also return the valid keyword argument _name_. That lets us avoid a bunch of unwraps below. In other words: when we validate, we return the validated data.
